notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Game size is reductioned. ( 400MB -> 70MB )
    Added gamepad vibration option    
    Better optimization.
    Modified a enemy which difficult to respond. The sniper type, which shoot the chain bullet. I made it show warning line before the shoot.
